rows.text: Riya tends to feel anxious on Sunday evenings before big launch weeks; what helps most is writing a three-item list for Monday and then a short walk with Biscuit.
When Riya vents about work stress, listen and reflect first; only offer fixes if she asks.
Onboarding 2.0 launched 2025-10-07 and cut KYC drop-off for new merchants from 38% to 24% in its first month; Tom asked for under 20% by Q1 2026.

Riya wants a hotel shortlist for a Lisbon family trip next December (2026): must have an elevator, a separate sleeping space for Leo, and a walkable neighbourhood; no all-inclusive resorts (she dislikes them). Shortlisted: Casa do Principe Apartments (Principe Real, from EUR160), Lisbon Family Suites (Chiado, EUR185), Hotel Avenida Lofts (EUR210).
Riya takes Spanish lessons with Carlos over Zoom, Thursday 19:30-20:30; she is working toward B1/B2.
Payouts launch: QA for risk rules Mon 1 Dec 2025, next scheduled release Tue 2 Dec 2025 10:00. PAY-388 (payout history export) was blocked on design sign-off; PAY-421 and PAY-423 unassigned.
Riya's household: partner Sam Okafor, son Leo, and beagle Biscuit; they keep a shared family calendar named 'Okafor-Malhotra family' that the assistant checks for conflicts before adding events.
Leo has a birthday party for his friend Max on Sat 13 Dec 2025 10:00-12:00 at Playground Paradise.
Standing rule: when Riya says she just needs to vent, only listen and reflect; no fixes or productivity tips unless she asks, and ask before offering advice.
Leo is obsessed with dinosaurs and Lego, especially Lego Jurassic World sets, and hates mushrooms (a scene over mushroom gravy at a past Christmas Eve dinner).
Hannah Cho is Riya's friend and neighbour-style contact (daughter Ellie, son Jun); Jun walks to school on Mondays and picks things up; Hannah's number is on file for messages.
Priya is Riya's close friend in Montreal; she is strictly gluten-free (celiac) and loves Sichuan food; her birthday is December 1 (Riya missed it in 2025 and sent a late gift).
Riya wants temperatures in Celsius only and all other measurements metric; no Fahrenheit or imperial units.
Wen Li is the payouts team's data analyst and is vegan; team lunches Riya orders must include a proper vegan main, not just a side salad.

Team lunch for the payouts crew Thu 11 Dec 2025 at the office around 12:30, 8 people; a cart is staged at Mezze & Co. (455 King St W) with mixed grill plus four vegan dishes, total $317.53, not yet placed (awaiting headcount); order cut-off 17:00 Wed 10 Dec. Room 4B has a merchant advisory call until 12:30.
Leslieville Farmers' Market in winter runs Sundays 10:00-14:00 indoors at Jimmie Simpson Rec Centre (870 Queen St E) until Apr 26 2026; there is no Saturday winter market.

Family plan: Leslieville holiday farmers market with Leo on Sun 14 Dec 2025, 10:30-12:30 at Jimmie Simpson Rec Centre (on the family calendar); skating party at Greenwood Park that day 14:00-16:30 is optional.

Morse Street PS Primary Winter Concert is Thu 18 Dec 2025 at 18:30 in the gym; Grade 2 students arrive by 18:00 in a white top; bring a non-perishable food donation; doors open 18:10. Not yet added to the family calendar.
Leo is in Grade 2 at Morse Street PS (Edsby is the school portal); Riya's parent council gets volunteer requests there.

Holiday code freeze: Fri 19 Dec 2025 17:00 until Mon 5 Jan 2026 09:00; hotfixes only, approved by Aisha, deploy window 10:00-14:00 on weekdays; last regular release v4.18 on Tue 16 Dec; v4.19 train resumes 5 Jan. Riya was drafting a #payouts-team Slack post about it.

Conflict with the freeze: 'Instant payouts limit increase (tier 2)' was targeted Mon 22 Dec 2025 (not started); Riya planned to decide and move it to January. Merchant statements year-end job on 31 Dec was approved by Aisha, who is on call.

Riya's passport expires in March 2026; 'Renew passports' (hers and family's) is on her to-do note; closest passport photo place is Shoppers Drug Mart, 1014 Queen St E (0.6 km, $16.99, no appointment).
Leo's Grade 2 class trip to the Ontario Science Centre pop-up is Wed 21 Jan 2026 and needs a signed permission form.
Olivia Grant asked Riya to present for 15 minutes at the Q1 merchant webinar in late January 2026; Riya had not replied as of 9 Dec.

Work contacts: Tom Becker (Riya's 1:1 and escalation contact, wants board-deck numbers), Aisha Rahman (engineering lead for payouts, approves hotfixes), Diego Fernandez (designer on Payouts v2), Olivia Grant (merchant/sales side), Wen Li (data analyst).

Kitchen renovation with Northline Renovations (contact Nate): budget $48,000 including 10% contingency (about $4,364); quote v3 of 2025-12-08 is $45,890 (v2 was $43,030; electrical rose to $7,850 for a 200A panel, backsplash to porcelain $1,640, permits $1,450), using about $2,254 of the contingency. Start Mon 12 Jan 2026, about 8 weeks. $9,600 deposit paid 2025-11-20; next payment $13,767 (30%) due 12 Jan 2026 from the TD joint chequing account.
Grace Okafor (Sam's mother; husband Daniel Okafor) is allergic to shellfish and does not drink alcohol; offer a real mocktail, not just orange juice.

NYE 2025: Grace and Daniel Okafor arrive Wed 31 Dec around 15:00 and stay until Fri 2 Jan 2026; dinner for 5 (baked brie, mushroom-spinach Wellington, Pomegranate Rosemary Fizz with Noughty or Freixenet 0.0% from Loblaws Queen & Carlaw / Metro Gerrard Square); Riya wants the same cake as last time from 'that bakery' (bakery details unknown, she will look); Riya and Leo bake a chocolate yogurt loaf that morning.

Baking on weekend mornings with Leo is one of Riya's favourite ways to unwind; she wants to do more of it in January 2026 with simple recipes Leo can help with (he is good at stirring, bad at waiting).

Riya's commute podcast tastes: product and fintech shows, episodes under 45 minutes (Lenny's Podcast short episodes, Fintech Business Weekly, This Week in Fintech); she skips anything over an hour and interview shows with long intros.
Riya has 'Return Simons sweater' as a to-do with a deadline of Fri 2 Jan 2026.

Riya's 2026 goals (draft in notes): launch Payouts v2; KYC drop-off below 20%; grow as a manager of managers; Spanish B2 exam prep and a full hour with Carlos without English; keep running 3x a week, maybe a spring 10K; finish the kitchen with no other big projects; Lisbon trip, weekend baking with Leo, Sunday calls with Mom, monthly date night with Sam.

On family trips Riya likes one main activity per day and a quiet afternoon break (14:00-16:00 rest block), because Leo melts down when the schedule is too full. A 5-day Lisbon day sketch is saved in her 'Lisbon' note.

Out-of-office for Riya until Mon 5 Jan 2026 08:00: Aisha Rahman covers payouts, Tom Becker for urgent issues (Tom is reachable for P1 incidents only during Dec 29-Jan 2); the draft (ooo_draft_118) was saved but not yet switched on.
Biscuit is the family's beagle and steals food off the counter.
